name: Enthalpy v0.4.3
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.3

## Fixed

- Repairs an isolated legacy UUIDv4 note ID before Enthalpy starts Sync.
- Stops safely and names the related file when another current workspace file still uses the legacy note ID.
- Keeps the strict UUIDv7 workspace format and does not send invalid local data to Hosted Sync.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS Apple Silicon.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic review is complete.
- Windows Sync enrollment remains disabled.
